era: Last Glacial Maximum (LGM Climax) / Solutrean & Epigravettian Refugia

overview.summary_fr: Reconstitution cartographique et tensorielle globale de la Terre pour l'époque -20 000 BP (apogée du Dernier Maximum Glaciaire / LGM). Le niveau moyen des mers atteint son minimum eustatique (-125 à -130 m). Les inlandsis laurentidien, cordillérien et fennoscandien atteignent leur extension maximale, poussant les populations humaines vers des refuges climatiques méridionaux : le refuge franco-cantabrique (culture solutréenne : feuilles de laurier, propulseurs), les refuges méditerranéens (Épigravettien), le Levant (Kébarien), la Béringie non englacée, et les refuges subtropicaux d'Asie et d'Afrique. Les Amériques au sud des calottes glaciaires restent rigoureusement inhabitées.
overview.summary_en: Global cartographic and tensor reconstruction for the -20,000 BP epoch (Peak Last Glacial Maximum / LGM). Global eustatic sea level drops to its lowest level (-125 to -130m). Continental ice sheets reach maximum extent, forcing human populations into southern ecological refugia: Franco-Cantabrian (Solutrean: laurel-leaf bifaces, spearthrowers), Mediterranean/Balkans (Epigravettian), Levant (Kebaran), unglaciated Beringia, and subtropical African/Asian refuges. The Americas south of the ice sheets remain strictly uninhabited.

data_sources: GEBCO 2023 Grid Bathymetric and Topographic Model
Peltier et al. (2015) ICE-6G_C GIA Reconstruction

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.paleotopographic_features: Doggerland fully terrestrial; Beringia land bridge >1200 km wide; Sunda and Sahul mega-continents at maximum land area.

elevation.reconstitution_rationale: Peak eustatic sea level drop of -128m exposing continental shelves worldwide.

data_sources: Ray & Adams (2001) LGM Global Biome Database

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.hyper_arid_deserts: Massive expansion of Saharan, Arabian, and Gobi sand dunes
scientific_parameters_and_corrections.mammoth_steppe_refugia: Continuous cold steppe across unglaciated Eurasia

biomes.reconstitution_rationale: Extreme aridity and cold suppressing tropical forests and expanding desert/tundra belts.

data_sources: EPICA Dome C Antarctic Ice Core
MARGO Project (2009) Glacial Sea Surface Temperature Synthesis
temperature.reconstitution_rationale: Coldest planetary state of the last 100,000 years (~6°C colder than pre-industrial).

data_sources: Global Speleothem δ18O Synthesis (Cheng et al. 2016)

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.monsoon_collapse: Severe weakening of tropical convection and summer monsoons

precipitation.reconstitution_rationale: Widespread global continental desiccation and hyper-arid dust storms.

seasonality.reconstitution_rationale: Extreme continental seasonality with brutally harsh winters.

data_sources: Tallavaara et al. (2015) 'Human population dynamics in Europe over the Last Glacial Maximum'
Bocquet-Appel et al. (2005) 'Estimates of Upper Palaeolithic meta-population in South-Western France'

strict_uninhabited_regions: North America south of Laurentide ice sheet

density.reconstitution_rationale: Pronounced demographic bottleneck with dense population clusters in southern micro-climatic refugia (Franco-Cantabria, Southern Italy, Balkans, Levant, Sundaland).

isogloss.reconstitution_rationale: Fragmentation of language networks into isolated glacial refugia.

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.refuge_territorial_defense: High band density in river valleys with marked cave boundary markers

sovereignty.reconstitution_rationale: Intensified territoriality within constrained refuge valleys (Dordogne, Cantabria).

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.kinship_mode: Exogamous alliance networks connecting neighboring refuge valleys

kinship.reconstitution_rationale: Regional mating networks ensuring genetic viability across small refuge clusters.

data_sources: Cosquer Cave, Cussac Cave, Altamira Solutrean Layer

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.parietal_sanctuaries: Deep cave painting sanctuaries with hand stencils and polychrome animal figures

rituals.reconstitution_rationale: High symbolic explosion in deep limestone caves serving as ritual aggregation hubs.

data_sources: Smith (1966) 'The Solutrean Culture of Western Europe'
Invention of Spearthrower (Atlatl) and Pressure Flaking

technological_innovations: Pressure-flaked laurel-leaf and willow-leaf bifacial points
Spearthrower (Atlatl) increasing projectile kinetic range by 3x
Bone eyed needles and tailored waterproof hide garments
Early ceramic experimentation in Southern China (Xianrendong)

technology.reconstitution_rationale: Apex of Paleolithic lithic craftsmanship and mechanical projectile propulsion.

institutional.reconstitution_rationale: Egalitarian bands with specialized master knappers and ritual leaders.

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.refuge_hunting_pressure: Concentrated hunting of reindeer, horse, and ibex in refuge valleys

ecological.reconstitution_rationale: Intensive exploitation of cold-adapted herd fauna.

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.pathogen_pressure: Suppressed globally by glacial hyper-aridity and cold

pathogen.reconstitution_rationale: Minimum historical pathogen transmission due to low global demographic density.

tradenetwork.reconstitution_rationale: Dense raw material exchange between Franco-Cantabrian valleys.

precious_metals.reconstitution_rationale: Intact placer gold and silver deposits.
